note.en: Wi-Fi is reported but its speed hasn't been measured.
note.zh: 有Wi-Fi，但网速没人实测过。

note.en: Spacious room that feels a bit like a mini coworking space.
note.zh: 空间很大，有点像迷你共享办公室。

blurb.en: Roomy roaster cafe across from the Navy Yard. It has Wi-Fi and a mini-coworking feel, with people on laptops, though turnover is high.
blurb.zh: Navy Yard对面的烘焙咖啡馆，空间宽敞，有Wi-Fi，氛围有点像小型共享办公室，常有人开电脑干活。客流量大，翻台快。

en: High turnover, so tables aren't always wiped. Check for crumbs and spills before setting your laptop down.
Opens at 6am on weekdays, but closes at 7pm every day.
zh: 客人进进出出很多，桌子不一定擦干净，放电脑前先看一眼。
工作日早上6点就开门，不过每天晚上7点关门。

name: Hunters Point Library
address: 47-40 Center Blvd, Long Island City, NY 11109

note.en: Free QPL Wi-Fi with no sign-in, reachable about 450 ft from the building even when closed; speed unknown.
note.zh: 有免费 QPL Wi-Fi，不用登录，闭馆时在楼外约140米内也能连，网速未知。

note.en: Public library with free Wi-Fi and remote printing.
note.zh: 公共图书馆，免费Wi-Fi，还能远程打印。

blurb.en: Steven Holl's waterfront library with Manhattan skyline views through big carved windows, reading areas on cantilevered floors and rooftop bleacher seating. Free, open Sundays.
blurb.zh: Steven Holl 设计的江边图书馆，大块异形窗正对曼哈顿天际线，悬挑楼层是阅读区，顶楼还有阶梯座位。免费，周日也开。

en: Tuesday opens at 1pm; most days close at 6pm.
Outlets and study-room availability unconfirmed.
zh: 周二下午1点才开，大部分日子6点就关。
插座和自习室情况没查到。

note.en: BPL says free Wi-Fi (BPLUNWIRED) is available at every branch; speed here not verified.
note.zh: BPL官网说每个分馆都有免费Wi-Fi（BPLUNWIRED），这家网速没实测。

note.en: Free public Wi-Fi at all BPL branches; no laptop restrictions listed.
note.zh: BPL所有分馆都有免费Wi-Fi，没看到任何限制用电脑的规定。

note.en: Meeting rooms can be requested through BPL's room reservation site.
note.zh: 会议室可以在BPL的预约系统里申请。

note.en: ADA-accessible restroom, entered from the back entrance on Pacific St.
note.zh: 有无障碍洗手间，要从Pacific St那边的后门进。

blurb.en: Historic Carnegie branch at Fourth Ave and Pacific, near Barclays Center. Free, with meeting rooms the public can reserve. Open until 8pm on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
blurb.zh: Barclays Center旁边的百年老图书馆，免费，会议室可以预约。周二周四开到晚上8点。

en: Closed Sundays, and opens only at 1pm on Tuesdays.
Expected to close for renovation from summer 2027 to fall 2029.
zh: 周日不开，周二下午1点才开门。
预计2027年夏天开始闭馆装修，到2029年秋天才重开。

note.en: Free, password-protected Wi-Fi on weekdays; it is switched off on weekends. Speed not reported.
note.zh: 工作日有免费Wi-Fi，要密码；周末直接关掉。网速没人测过。

note.en: Only source is a Jan 2024 article.
note.zh: 只有一篇2024年1月的文章提到，信息偏旧。

note.en: Background music, but most people are working so there is little chatter.
note.zh: 有背景音乐，但大家基本都在干活，很少有人聊天。

note.en: Wi-Fi is shut off on weekends to keep it laptop-free; plan to work Mon–Fri. The 2015 source may refer to another branch.
note.zh: 周末关Wi-Fi，就是不想让人开电脑久坐，建议周一到周五来。2015年那篇可能说的是别的分店。

blurb.en: Bright Devoción with 18-ft windows and an indoor tropical garden. Weekdays it's a calm room of people working to background music; on weekends the Wi-Fi goes off.
blurb.zh: 18英尺落地窗+室内热带植物园，颜值超高。工作日基本都是安静干活的人，配着背景音乐；周末关Wi-Fi，别来办公。

en: Wi-Fi is turned off on weekends.
Closes at 6pm every day.
zh: 周末不开Wi-Fi。
每天下午6点就关门。

note.en: A Sept 2026 guide says none of Irving Farm's cafes have Wi-Fi; it doesn't review this branch specifically.
note.zh: 2026年9月的攻略说Irving Farm所有店都没有Wi-Fi，不过没专门写这家分店。

note.en: A Sept 2026 guide says laptops are tolerated (with your own hotspot) only at the Upper West Side shop; nothing specific for this location.
note.zh: 2026年9月的攻略说只有 UWS 那家默许开电脑（要自带热点），这家没有明确说法。

note.en: Guide advises against loud calls or meetings at Irving Farm shops in general.
note.zh: 攻略建议在 Irving Farm 各家店都别大声打电话或开会。

blurb.en: Roomy, wood-lined Irving Farm by Washington Square Park with plenty of seats. Wi-Fi reports conflict, so treat it as a hotspot spot.
blurb.zh: 华盛顿广场旁边的 Irving Farm，木质装修，座位多。Wi-Fi 有没有说法不一，建议当成自带热点的地方。

en: Irving Farm cafes reportedly have no Wi-Fi; bring a hotspot.
Closes at 5pm every day.
Calls and meetings are discouraged.
zh: 据说Irving Farm各家店都没Wi-Fi，记得自带热点。
每天下午5点就关门。
不太欢迎打电话和开会。

name: Sweetleaf
address: 10-93 Jackson Ave, Long Island City, NY 11101

note.en: Listing (updated Oct 2026) says free Wi-Fi at Sweetleaf Coffee Roasters but gives no address; speed not reported.
note.zh: 榜单（2026年10月更新）说Sweetleaf Coffee Roasters有免费Wi-Fi，但没写是哪家店，网速也没提。

note.en: Undated listing; not explicitly tied to the Jackson Ave branch.
note.zh: 来源没日期，也没明确说是Jackson Ave这家。

note.en: A listing says no screens on weekends; a 2026 guide calls the Jackson Ave cafe work-friendly. Weekend rule not confirmed by the venue.
note.zh: 有榜单说周末不让用电脑；2026年的攻略说Jackson Ave这家适合办公。周末规定店家官方没确认。

note.en: Listing mentions a customer bathroom; not explicitly tied to the Jackson Ave address.
note.zh: 榜单说有给顾客用的洗手间，但没明确是Jackson Ave这家。

blurb.en: Sweetleaf's Jackson Ave cafe in LIC. Reviews describe a living-room feel and a quieter laptop room in back. Weekend screen rules are reported, so come on weekdays.
blurb.zh: Sweetleaf在LIC Jackson Ave的店，据说像客厅一样舒服，后面有个更安静的电脑区。听说周末不让开电脑，建议工作日来。

en: Reportedly no laptops/screens on weekends.
Closes at 7pm.
zh: 据说周末不让开电脑。
晚上7点关门。

note.en: Two guides confirm Wi-Fi, one calls it reliable; no speed data.
note.zh: 两篇攻略都说有Wi-Fi，其中一篇说挺稳，没有测速。

note.en: Plenty of space on weekdays, but can get busy enough that people take orders to go.
note.zh: 工作日空位多，但人多时可能只能外带。

note.en: No limit found; a customer review on the cafe's listing wishes there were one.
note.zh: 没查到限时规定，有顾客评论还说希望店里设个时间限制。

busyTimes.en: Best on weekdays; can get busy enough that you'll take your drink to go.
busyTimes.zh: 工作日去最好，人多的时候可能只能外带。

blurb.en: Low-key Astoria cafe with warm brown walls, plants and reliable Wi-Fi. Known for its iced matcha einspänner and egg sando; weekdays are the time to settle in.
blurb.zh: Astoria的低调小店，棕色墙配绿植，网很稳。招牌是冰抹茶einspänner和鸡蛋三明治，工作日来最舒服。

en: Can get crowded; Saturdays often mean a wait, and weekends are a gamble for seats.
Hours unconfirmed: third-party listings say 7am–6pm but disagree on whether it closes Tuesdays.
zh: 人多时很挤，周六经常要排队，周末不一定有位子。
营业时间没官方确认：第三方页面写早7点到晚6点，但周二开不开说法不一。

note.en: Hours of the lobby Intelligentsia coffee bar; the lobby itself may stay open later.
note.zh: 这是大堂 Intelligentsia 咖啡吧的营业时间，大堂本身可能开得更久。

note.en: The hotel advertises its 'fastest free Wi-Fi'; not independently tested.
note.zh: 酒店自己宣传「最快免费Wi-Fi」，没有第三方实测。

note.en: Guides say guests and non-guests work in the lobby, but the main source is from 2019.
note.zh: 指南说住客和非住客都在大堂办公，但主要来源是2019年的。

note.en: An undated guide says the lobby nooks suit online meetings; no venue policy found.
note.zh: 一篇没标日期的攻略说大堂角落适合开线上会，酒店没有明确规定。

blurb.en: Chelsea hotel by the High Line with an Intelligentsia coffee bar in the lobby, banquettes and sofas, and a garden courtyard in good weather.
blurb.zh: High Line 旁边的酒店，大堂里有 Intelligentsia 咖啡吧，卡座和沙发都能坐，天气好还能去花园。

en: Coffee bar closes at 5pm.
Lobby-work tolerance is based on older reports; buy a coffee.
zh: 咖啡吧下午5点关。
能不能在大堂久坐主要是旧资料说的，最好点杯咖啡。

name: David Rubenstein Atrium at Lincoln Center

note.en: Free Wi-Fi reported by Lonely Planet (undated); speed not measured.
note.zh: Lonely Planet提到有免费Wi-Fi（没写日期），网速没实测。

note.en: POPS rules require 152 chairs and 38 tables, but Lincoln Center's own page now says seating is limited and first-come, first-served.
note.zh: 按POPS规定要有152把椅子、38张桌子，但Lincoln Center官网现在写的是座位有限、先到先得。

note.en: Movable tables can be pulled together.
note.zh: 桌子可以移动，能拼桌。

note.en: Accessible, gender-neutral restrooms.
note.zh: 有无障碍、不分性别的洗手间。

busyTimes.en: Free performances, often Thursday evenings, fill the room and limit seating.
busyTimes.zh: 有免费演出的时候（经常是周四晚上）人很多，座位会被占满。

blurb.en: Lincoln Center's free public atrium, with lots of tables and chairs, restrooms and a café. Open late every day; free shows can take over the room.
blurb.zh: Lincoln Center的免费公共中庭，桌椅很多，有洗手间和咖啡店，每天开到晚上10点。有免费演出时会比较吵。

en: Free performances (often Thursdays) bring crowds and noise, and seating goes first-come during events.
The in-house café is only open Tue–Sat 9am–5pm.
Outlets unconfirmed.
zh: 有免费演出时（经常是周四）人多又吵，座位先到先得。
里面的咖啡店只在周二到周六9点到17点营业。
插座情况没确认。

name: Moxy NYC Downtown (Recreation)
address: 26 Ann St, 3rd Floor, New York, NY

note.en: Open network that worked well (2023 review).
note.zh: 开放网络不用密码，好用（2023年信息）。

note.en: Outlets under the bar, by couches and bar seats (2023).
note.zh: 吧台下、沙发旁都有插座（2023年）。

note.en: Two-tops, a 12-seat long table, two lounge areas and bar seats (2023).
note.zh: 有两人桌、12人长桌、两块沙发区和吧台（2023年）。

note.en: Often loud: bar, restaurant and games like skee-ball and shuffleboard.
note.zh: 经常很吵，有酒吧、餐厅，还有各种游戏机。

note.en: Pitched as daytime laptop space in 2021 and reviewed as a WFH spot in 2023; no current venue policy found.
note.zh: 2021年的报道说白天可以开电脑办公，2023年也有人当办公点测评过；现在的官方规定没查到。

note.en: Long table seats 12.
note.zh: 长桌能坐12人。

note.en: Two single-occupancy gender-neutral restrooms.
note.zh: 两个单人无性别洗手间。

blurb.en: Third-floor hotel lounge off Broadway with a 12-seat long table, couches, lots of outlets and open Wi-Fi. Fun for group sessions, but games and a bar keep it loud.
blurb.zh: FiDi的Moxy酒店三楼，有12人长桌、沙发、很多插座，Wi-Fi不用密码。适合一群人来，但有酒吧和游戏，比较吵。

en: Only a 2023 review found; current hours and access not reconfirmed.
Loud: bar plus arcade-style games.
Expect to buy food or drinks.
zh: 只找到2023年的测评，现在营业时间和开放情况没再确认。
很吵，有酒吧还有游戏。
最好点点吃的喝的。

note.en: No current hours found.
note.zh: 没找到最新营业时间。

note.en: Fast in a 2023 test; newer listings only confirm free, password-protected Wi-Fi.
note.zh: 2023年的实测网速很快；最近的攻略只提到有免费Wi-Fi、需要密码。

note.en: A handful of outlets on one wall (2023 review).
note.zh: 2023年的测评说只有一面墙上有几个插座。

note.en: A 2023 count found about a dozen seats; a 2025 guide says there are plenty.
note.zh: 2023年测评数下来大概十几个座位，2025年的攻略却说座位很多，说法不一。

note.en: A Sept 2026 guide calls it known for being good for working; no written laptop rules found.
note.zh: 2026年9月的攻略说这家出了名的适合办公，没看到店里有限制电脑的规定。

note.en: Shared table for four plus a three-seat couch (2023).
note.zh: 有一张四人共享桌和一张三人沙发（2023年信息）。

note.en: The space can be booked for events or meetings, not a separate room.
note.zh: 整个店面可以预订办活动或开会，不是单独的会议室。

blurb.en: Bright, wood-lined cafe near Canal St with couches, big windows and good music. Wi-Fi is quick, outlets are scarce, and the whole space can be booked for meetups.
blurb.zh: Canal St附近的木质风咖啡馆，有沙发，落地窗采光超好，音乐也好听。网速快但插座少，整个场地还能预订来办小聚会。

en: Only a handful of outlets, all on one wall; come charged.
Wi-Fi is password-protected; ask at the counter.
zh: 插座很少，只集中在一面墙，记得充满电再去。
Wi-Fi有密码，点单时问店员。

note.en: Official site; daytime is coffee hall, evenings become a cocktail hall.
note.zh: 官网时间；白天是咖啡厅，晚上变成鸡尾酒吧。

note.en: Plugs beside nearly every seating cluster along the outer walls.
note.zh: 靠外墙的座位区基本都有插座。

note.en: High ceilings carry sound; bring headphones (2024 review).
note.zh: 挑高很高，声音会传，建议带耳机（2024 年测评）。

note.en: Three communal tables seating eight each.
note.zh: 有三张 8 人长桌。

note.en: Daytime coffee seating is first come, first served; only evening tables take Resy reservations.
note.zh: 白天咖啡时段先到先得，只有晚上的座位能在Resy上订。

blurb.en: Art deco former bank hall turned coffee-and-cocktail hall: green lamps, couches, three 8-seat communal tables, fast Wi-Fi and plenty of plugs. Not quiet.
blurb.zh: 老银行大厅改的咖啡厅+酒吧，复古绿台灯、沙发，还有三张 8 人长桌。网快插座多，适合约人开会，但不算安静。

en: Not a quiet room: the soaring ceiling carries chatter, so bring headphones.
Evenings switch to a cocktail hall with Resy reservations; daytime coffee is first come, first served.
Weekend brunch runs 10am–3pm.
zh: 挑高大厅很吵，记得带耳机。
晚上变成鸡尾酒吧，要在 Resy 订位；白天咖啡先到先得。
周末 10am–3pm 有 brunch。

note.en: Consistent, never dropped in many sessions; reaches the patio.
note.zh: 网很稳，泡了很多次从没掉线，户外座也有信号。

note.en: Outlet at 13 of 14 indoor tables.
note.zh: 室内14张桌子13张有插座。

note.en: About 14 two-person tables, 3 window stools, plus 9 patio tables.
note.zh: 大约14张两人桌、3个窗边高脚凳，外加9张户外桌。

note.en: Rarely loud; seating is away from the counter, music at moderate volume.
note.zh: 很少吵，座位离点单区远，音乐音量适中。

note.en: During weekend brunch, all tables are held for dine-in from the brunch menu.
note.zh: 周末早午餐时段所有桌子只给点brunch堂食的人。

note.en: Reviewer flags two corner tables behind a column as good for meetings.
note.zh: 博主推荐角落柱子后面的两张桌子，适合开会。

note.en: Almost all two-tops.
note.zh: 基本都是两人桌。

note.en: The cafe says it does not take reservations; tables are first come, first served.
note.zh: 店家官网说不接受预约，座位先到先得。

note.en: One single-occupancy restroom, no code.
note.zh: 一个单人洗手间，不用密码。

blurb.en: Hell's Kitchen cafe near Clinton park with an outlet at nearly every table, steady Wi-Fi (even on the patio) and calm music. Mostly two-tops, so best solo or in pairs.
blurb.zh: Hell's Kitchen的宝藏咖啡馆，几乎每张桌子都有插座，网很稳，户外座也能连。音乐不吵，基本都是两人桌，适合一个人或两个人来。

en: Weekend brunch: tables held for brunch dine-in only.
Closes at 5pm daily.
Almost all two-person tables; not for groups.
zh: 周末早午餐时段桌子只留给点brunch的堂食客人。
每天5点关门。
几乎全是两人桌，不适合多人。
